sn35.89:1.1: kho āyasmā Bāhiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pāhitatto vihareyyan ti || ||
sn35.89:2.1: Taṃ kim maññasi Bāhiya cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:4.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukkaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:6.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.89:9.1: Aniccā bhante Cakkhuviññāṇam || || Cakkhusamphasso || la || || Yam idam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukham vā || tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:11.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:13.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ kallan nu tam anupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.89:15.1: Evam passaṃ Bāhiya sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi || rūpesu pi || cakkhuviññāṇe pi || cakkhusamphasse pi || pe || yampidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukkhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tasmim pi nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimuttasmim pī vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
sn35.89:16.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo eko vupakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tadanuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññāya sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi || || Aññataro ca panāyasmā Bāhiyo arahataṃ ahosīti || ||
